scope: Observed first structural divergence on the fixed 11-feature DEV chip; not a proof of every 20-chip mismatch. Initial empty-chip hook was corrected separately.
hypothesis: Tiny FP32 backbone/encoder rounding swaps near-tied proposal ranks; learned query features bind by rank, so downstream outputs are not merely permuted. Mask amplification also exists on chips without rank swaps.
next_bounded_comparison: Opset 16 explicit LayerNorm reductions, ORT optimizations disabled; unchanged FP32 PyTorch reference and strict 20-chip tolerances.
